//: Standalone config for the one-off backfill/seed scripts. It extends nothing: these files sit OUTSIDE mytribe/functions, so the functions base (rootDir 'src') would refuse them. They are executed by `npm run backfill:*` / `seed:*` from mytribe/functions via ts-node, as CommonJS under Node, which is why 'nodenext' is the right model here and not 'bundler'.
//paths: LOAD-BEARING, and not merely legacy node10 scaffolding. mytribe/scripts has no node_modules of its own and is a SIBLING of mytribe/functions, so nothing on the walk-up path carries these packages; this block is the compile-time twin of the `NODE_PATH=node_modules` those npm scripts set at run time (tsc ignores NODE_PATH). Verified under nodenext: dropping the block entirely fails 18 files with TS2307 on 'vitest'. The explicit 'firebase-admin/*' entry is separately load-bearing, because the catch-all substitutes '../functions/node_modules/firebase-admin/app', a path with no file, after which tsc falls back to a walk-up that on a developer machine can reach a STRAY $HOME/node_modules/firebase-admin (observed: v13.8 shadowing the project's 14.2.0) and on CI resolves to nothing at all. It bypasses the package's `exports` map, but lands on exactly the './lib/app/index.d.ts' that map's `require` condition points at, so nothing is masked.
//baseUrl: Deliberately absent. 'baseUrl' is deprecated in TS 6 and removed in TS 7, the same deadline that retires node10 resolution. `paths` has been resolved relative to this file since TS 4.1, so the only entry that needed it was the catch-all's own-directory fallback, rewritten from '*' to './*' to be relative.
//ts-node: Must track the module setting above; 'commonjs' here against 'nodenext' resolution is the TS5110 pairing error and every backfill would fail to start. 'nodenext' still emits CommonJS, since no package.json above these files sets `type: module`.
//rootDir: TypeScript 6 requires rootDir to be explicit once the inferred common source directory (here, '../functions', because these scripts import functions/src code) no longer matches the directory containing this tsconfig.json; without it every backfill/seed/repair script fails to start with TS5011.
